summary: Woodside Energy Group filed a Form 6-K (foreign private issuer current report, US equivalent of an 8-K) furnishing the transcript of its 2026 Capital Markets Day held November 5, 2026 in Sydney, at which new CEO Liz Westcott, CFO Graham Tiver and CCO Mark Abbotsford outlined long-term strategy, a new capital strategy and shareholder distributions framework, and portfolio resilience. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation or advisor is disclosed; the filing is a routine investor presentation with no special-situation event. Watch for follow-through on capital-return commitments and portfolio actions rather than any deal mechanics.
